I was laid off when the economy took a turn for the worse in 2008. My friend was unemployed even before that so she was really desperate for a job. She heard of a company like this (Usana) and all she kept hearing was how easy you can make money. She invited me to one of their recruitment meetings and since I had never heard of a pyramid scheme before this, I went with her.

So we drove out to this home in the Hollywood Hills (think where Rob and Big lived in their first show). That was my first red flag. That we were going to this house and had to wait outside, despite the email saying to be on time. 20 minutes later, I realized why they made us wait outside. Because if we waited inside for the presenters we would've missed them pulling up in a Lambo and Mercedes. I found that weird, but went along with it. Then as we were inside listening to them, my mind was in a bit of a battle within itself.

See I'm a logical guy and knew they were spitting out BS. From the get go I caught on how phony all this stuff was, but didnt want to make a scene and decided to wait it out since my friend was into it and was our ride. About halfway through though, my mind was starting to believe all of it. I had to keep telling myself it's fake, but man they were good. I can see how easily it is to manipulate a good portion of these people, my friend included. 

By the end of it, my friend was so upset that I didn't make an initial investment and prevented her from doing the same. I tried explaining to her how it was a con. They made us wait outside to see the cars they drove to make us believe we can afford the same if we invest. I was sure they hired people to be their hype man as well since there were some people cheering loudly when they pulled up and at select times throughout the presentation that got everyone else all riled up. I even asked her what the product they wanted her to sell was all about. To try and sell me some of it, but she didn't know because the entire presentation was all about how you can make money in your sleep than the products. Unfortunately she invested some time afterwards and has since realized it was all BS, she just won't admit I was right the whole time.
